summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-11-24 ~ 2026-11-26）

- ✨ x86 统一内核覆盖率框架并加入 Clang 源码级覆盖率与 MC/DC 支持（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ✨ arm64 最小 DWARF CFI 展开同时支持用户态与内核态栈回溯，降低对帧指针的依赖（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ KVM x86 PMU 改为动态中介上下文切换，按需切换 PMU 状态以降低虚拟化开销（[Virtualization](#subsystem-Virtualization)）
- ✨ VFS 新增 inode 批量遍历接口，替换 drop_caches/quota/gfs2 等处的逐 inode 循环（[Filesystem & Storage](#subsystem-Filesystem%20%26%20Storage)）
- 🛡 dma-buf 增加 memcg 记账与跨进程 charge 转移及 LSM 钩子，共享缓冲内存可被 cgroup 计量管控（[Security](#subsystem-Security)）
- ⚡ percpu_counter 改用 rwlock 支持并发求和，降低多核计数汇总的串行化开销（[Core Kernel](#subsystem-Core%20Kernel)）

## Drivers
- `perf` `other` 6.12.120-rc1 稳定评审汇总 816 个补丁，覆盖 arm64 errata、IIO 与网络等更新。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125143849.205329330@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` 6.18.66-rc1 稳定评审汇总 990 个补丁，含 arm64 GCS、ublk、KHO 等驱动/文档更新。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125143822.072087159@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` `other` 7.3.7-rc1 稳定评审汇总 1005 个补丁，覆盖 arm64 errata、overlayfs、xfrm、运行时 PM 等。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125143821.729802100@linuxfoundation.org/)
- `perf` MMC 核心调整忙状态轮询延迟，降低 __mmc_poll_for_busy 的等待开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/ebdff46271d3418483ddae57e31d1cba@zeshmbx09.spreadtrum.com/)
- 增加 LG V60 ThinQ 的 arm64 DTS、面板与触摸屏支持。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125032802.8460-1-rofikcoga@gmail.com/)
- IIO 核心新增基于 regmap 的 debugfs 寄存器访问，改造多个加速度/压力/ADC 驱动。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124065016.185124-1-zoone.rupert@gmail.com/)
- DRM 新增桥接器热插拔与 connector 辅助层，拆分 CEC/hotplug 逻辑供各桥接驱动复用。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-drm-bridge-hotplug-v4-0-822722850492@bootlin.com/)
- regmap 统一处理宽于 val_bits 的写入值，补 kunit 覆盖并适配 nau8360。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-regmap-kunit-val-bits-v2-0-81db3b79cd3f@gmail.com/)
- 为 Rust 设备抽象加入运行时电源管理接口，扩展 device/platform 供 tyr 驱动使用。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124113555.2480381-1-beata.michalska@arm.com/)
- DRM 新增裁剪地址辅助函数，供 imx/sun4i 修正显示缓冲区取址。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124074041.115251-1-wenst@chromium.org/)
- 另有 39 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-b4-sound-qcom-x1e80100-allow-ucm-channel-map-v4-0-1197ac8eacd2@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125182053.3915833-1-kamal.dasu@broadcom.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124161001.702882-1-ckeepax@opensource.cirrus.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-gpiolib-chip-removal-v8-0-aambrozewicz@nvidia.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/179550361711.991197.13876815308672111616@kylinos.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125140251.384361-1-andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-feat_move_i915_helper-v2-0-aa04d39bc415@bootlin.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125112158.938835-2-u.kleine-koenig@baylibre.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-gpiolib-setupdev-v1-1-aambrozewicz@nvidia.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125192053.5664-1-security@nitrohex.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-rust-drm-gem-shmem-imported-sgt-v2-0-000f7a9ccb8d@jannau.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125073009.3091-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) 等 39 项

## Architecture
- `perf` `bugfix` soc 7.4 修复集，涉及多平台 DTS 与 STM32 设备树修正。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/53b178d5-27b2-4718-8630-16f83a736227@app.fastmail.com/)
- `perf` 最小 DWARF CFI 展开同时支持用户态与内核态栈回溯，降低对帧指针的依赖。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125061523.1540234-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` 统一内核覆盖率框架，并加入 Clang 源码级覆盖率与 MC/DC 支持。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125020603.3934222-1-sashal@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `other` PCI qcom 依据温度漂移重新校准 PCIe PHY，提升链路稳定性。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-glymur-thermal-fix-v1-0-b93a9feae156@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `perf` Exynos7885 增加 USB 支持，含 PHY 驱动与 DWC3 设备树。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125145458.2594179-1-virag.david003@gmail.com/)
- `perf` accel/rocket 支持 RK3576 NPU（RKNN）。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795478392.git.gahing@gahingwoo.com/)
- `perf` 新增 Google Laguna CPM 时钟支持。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125000349.3385325-1-briannorris@chromium.org/)
- `perf` PCI 新增 Lane Margining at Receiver 的 debugfs 调试接口。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-pcie-link-endpoints-v8-0-19d49c17c05f@google.com/)
- `perf` x86 ITS 识别间接分支前的 CS 前缀，避免间接分支跟踪漏检。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-its-cs-prefix-v1-1-10f2c01687cf@linux.intel.com/)
- `perf` amlogic Odroid N2+ 启用 SD UHS 模式。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-n2plus-sd-uhs-v1-1-cc2019e68da8@iav.lv/)
- 另有 108 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-halliday-dts-v3-0-5c8311c0b70b@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125153911.106793-1-fuad.tabba@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124023558.4088635-1-eleanor.lin@realtek.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-glymur-v12-0-5c34dfd73fc2@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-upstream_nvram_reworked-v6-0-ea0cfccc20b0@foss.st.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-device-trust-core-v4-0-037eb0d17b1f@nvidia.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-dmaengine-support-wider-dma-masks-v7-0-5d57df2c3ebd@analog.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-rk3576-otp-cpuid-mac-v5-0-b3125c9a5fc8@flipper.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-rk3576-otp-cpuid-mac-v4-0-d403b8a25113@flipper.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124215048.42074-1-pmazzini@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-netrani-interconnect-v2-v2-0-4eab92854137@krgm.moe/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-mahua_iris_enable-v2-0-b1a16b16afca@oss.qualcomm.com/) 等 108 项

## Networking
- `perf` 新增 arm64 S32G SerDes 子系统（DT、stmmac dwmac-s32、PCS），打通以太网与 PCIe 的 SerDes 模式切换 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-s32g_serdes-v4-0-3bfe0589be8d@oss.nxp.com/)
- i3c 核心暴露控制器传输上限，mctp-i3c 据此拆分传输 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124060651.1987454-1-shubhamsanjay.patil@amd.com/)
- `perf` `other` XDP socket 收包改为按设备缓冲区布局，减少一层拷贝与 xdp_buff 转换开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124112707.118678-1-bjorn@kernel.org/)
- amt 支持 IPv6 外层传输，附 v4/v6 自测脚本 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125191450.2497936-1-omar@blockcast.net/)
- `perf` veth 在背压下提前唤醒与停止 txq，降低队列满导致的丢包 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125152311.805325-1-simon.schippers@tu-dortmund.de/)
- `perf` net: page_pool 清理 params kernel-doc 中 fast/slow 的过时描述 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125184640.2407270-1-takano32@gmail.com/)
- psp 引入无 socket 关联，配套 netlink 规范、mlx5 与 netdevsim 支持 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124221758.3230929-1-toddfreed@meta.com/)
- genetlink 拒绝加入无任何 family 拥有的多播组，避免无效订阅 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125144514.2717012-1-anilkaushikwireless@gmail.com/)
- stmmac 在 XGMAC 上支持最多 16 个 MTL/DMA 队列 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124000415.4067701-1-sagar.cheluvegowda@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- stmmac 可编程 FSM 超时定时器，覆盖 dwmac5 与 dwmac2 系列 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125111929.3395740-1-zxyan0222@gmail.com/)
- 另有 90 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125103153.53012-1-f3lix.dev@gmx.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-sparx5_l3_routing-v4-0-86a9bac28fcf@microchip.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124013124.3693-1-yanhaishuang@cmss.chinamobile.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-for-upstream-le-conn-params-rpa-v4-0-f2dd5eb41f45@podgorny.cz/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124010601.3995693-1-toddfreed@meta.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125020835.1132797-1-jianbol@nvidia.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795573672.git.kyuwoncho18@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125043847.885053-1-piyus@iiitd.ac.in/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/pm-bluetooth-objects-candidate-0218-followup-v2-88edfec8c72ed860e626-0@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124020559.1701707-1-xmei5@asu.edu/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124022107.32283-1-ljp1205831794@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/pm-bluetooth-objects-candidate-0069-v11-7d5800a0c21420dddac0-0@gmail.com/) 等 90 项

## Virtualization
- `perf` `bugfix` 将 KVM x86 PMU 改为动态中介上下文切换，按需切换 PMU 状态以降低虚拟化开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124002303.1785363-1-yosry@kernel.org/)
- `perf` 为 KVM x86 PMU 增加硬件 Topdown 指标支持，让 guest 可采集层级性能数据。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124213901.120572-1-zide.chen@intel.com/)
- 嵌套 VMX 切换时始终延迟 PMU 重编程，避免嵌套进出路径上的冗余 PMU 操作。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125182703.1694998-1-yosry@kernel.org/)
- VMX 处理 MMIO stale data 的 VERW 时不再关闭 FB_CLEAR，保持缓冲区清除能力。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124180613.1693632-1-amirmohammad.eftekhar@cispa.de/)
- `bugfix` 修复 nVMX 嵌套 APICv 模拟以兼容 Windows guest，避免虚拟中断投递异常。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125155819.408795-1-mlevitsk@redhat.com/)
- `bugfix` v4 版本修复 nVMX 嵌套 APICv 对 Windows guest 的模拟问题，提升嵌套虚拟化兼容性。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125052139.362046-1-mlevitsk@redhat.com/)
- `other` 拒绝为使用私有内存的 VM 启用 SMM，避免不支持的 SMM 与私有内存组合。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124032748.1221979-1-gdool88@gmail.com/)
- `perf` mshv 在映射 guest GPA 前执行 pre-commit，减少后续映射失败与重复工作。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125001054.1057035-1-mrathor@linux.microsoft.com/)
- `perf` vfio/pci 提供内核侧 BAR 对齐信息，支持将 BAR 映射到大页以降低映射开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124073048.268988-1-guanghuifeng@linux.alibaba.com/)
- `other` 将多处简单 mmap 钩子转换为 mmap_prepare，统一虚拟化驱动 mmap 回调路径。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-late-2026-mmap_prepare-v2-0-0b0d99d655f9@kernel.org/)
- 另有 5 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125134942.60776-1-amirmohammad.eftekhar@cispa.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-vsock-dgram-support-v4-0-3607484e85e8@redhat.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-tdx-guest-quote-poll-v4-0-d89f26854b88@flashbots.net/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124164446.2371939-1-vdonnefort@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-acrn-unpin-monitor-page-v1-1-097458800936@columbia.edu/)

## Observability
- `perf` udmabuf 大页后端缓冲的 mmap 加速，降低映射开销 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261123-feat-udmabuf-huge-pfnmap-v2-0-3254f801fc36@linux.dev/)
- `perf` tracefs 在 /sys/kernel/events 提供只读 eventfs，未挂载 tracefs 时也能读取事件元数据 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125084224.05ce5f35@gandalf.local.home/)
- `perf` `other` iommu 新增 I/O 页错误响应延迟 tracepoint，便于定位设备缺页性能问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125013430.2144822-1-zhangyuwei20@huawei.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 引入 perf coverage 测试框架并附其发现的修复，提升子命令回归防护 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125192312.34134-1-acme@kernel.org/)
- `perf` symbol 改用有序数组并压缩内存，加速符号查找、降低大样本内存占用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124223109.820609-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` `other` script 惰性加载符号，按需解析以减少启动耗时与常驻内存 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-perf-symbol-memory-send-v9-0-56f298185eae@uber.com/)
- `perf` 为缺少测试的 perf 子命令补充 shell 覆盖用例，改善回归防护 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124184604.24983-1-acme@kernel.org/)
- `perf` ftrace 7.5 更新，含 trace_btf 相关改进，扩展函数跟踪可用类型信息 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125181952.861853319@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `other` jevents 拒绝 JSON 表中的未知键，防止事件字段拼写错误被静默忽略 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125040016.1675748-1-takano32@gmail.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` jevents 以 helper 替代已弃用的 FileType，兼容新版 Python [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125173315.2359128-1-takano32@gmail.com/)
- 另有 33 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-james-perf-late-parse-attr-v3-1-f9e906dd9da5@linaro.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124032723.157254-1-qinyuntan@linux.alibaba.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124033328.612894-1-shanbeeyoo@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125060411.445-1-lee@jaeyeong.cc/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125-james-perf-kvm-live-file-v1-0-946f478ce2a1@linaro.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125180912.2388197-1-takano32@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124152845.2233401-1-vdonnefort@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125143138.47174-1-leon.hwang@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124224811.16134-1-ihor.solodrai@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125103208.15242-1-yangtiezhu@loongson.cn/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125083942.3695072-1-vikram.singh3@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125120226.1120235-1-dedemorow@gmail.com/) 等 33 项

## Power Management
- `perf` amd-pstate 引入容量感知调度，x86 混合平台结合 CPPC/HFI 按核容量选频，提升异构平台能效 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125172031.741740-1-Vishal.Badole@amd.com/)
- qcom_smbx 新增 PM4125 SMBLite 充电器支持及 DT 绑定，扩大 Qualcomm 充电驱动覆盖面 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-smblite-charger-for-pm4125-v1-0-2132c9f0601f@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- qcom-rpmh-regulator 新增 PM6450 支持，扩展 RPMh 调节器可覆盖的 PMIC 型号与 DT 绑定 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-netrani-pm6450-v1-v1-0-1914da758d3d@krgm.moe/)
- 另有 6 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-ds28e16-v1-0-bed431df0578@proton.me/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-adctm5_gen3_hardirq_removal-v3-1-c7923e9a54c1@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/ac17f1db-e8db-41d7-922b-6cb32c7096ec@web.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/de6c1040-c4d1-4703-9932-b3b668801c72@web.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125173959.2198116-1-christian.loehle@arm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124132756.1306906-1-christian.loehle@arm.com/)

## Filesystem & Storage
- PHY core 新增 bulk 获取/使能/释放辅助函数，供 ahci_imx、Cadence PCIe 等批量管理多条 PHY。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125043639.249525-1-inochiama@gmail.com/)
- `perf` VFS 新增 inode 批量遍历接口，替换 drop_caches/quota/gfs2 等处逐 inode 循环，减少遍历开销。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125091157.1822521-1-huangsj@hygon.cn/)
- `perf` `bugfix` ext4 更新集：分配器与块组、校验和、目录、KUnit 测试等多项修正与优化合入。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/awW86EI5fYafQx-o@mit.edu/)
- UFS core 为 PA TFS/FEC 错误计数器增加 debugfs 节点，便于现场定位链路错误。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125113435.1426680-1-powenkao@google.com/)
- exfat 新增 EXFAT_IOC_COMBINE ioctl，可把某文件的簇链追加到另一文件，支持零拷贝式合并。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124230746.850528-1-shaopei_1012@163.com/)

- `perf` gfs2 日志代码由 struct page 改为 folio，减少高阶内存碎片并简化日志缓冲处理。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-gfs2-log-folio-v2-0-f229e90c8285@columbia.edu/)
- `perf` `other` ksmbd 通过 TCP splice 直接发送 READ 负载，避免大块数据在内核态多余拷贝。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124132554.1185817-1-huiwen.he@linux.dev/)
- `perf` `bugfix` fat 读写 FAT 表项时持有缓冲区锁，避免并发更新丢失并减少竞态重试。 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125034336.3724504-1-yanghaoming@kaihong.com/)

## Security
- dma-buf 增加 memcg 记账与跨进程 charge 转移，新增 LSM 钩子与 dma-heap/tee-heap 接口，使共享缓冲内存可被 cgroup 计量与管控 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-v2_20230123_tjmercier_google_com-v6-0-dce12fa03ad6@redhat.com/)
- trusted keys 支持非对称密钥（v3）：新增 TPM2 会话与 ASN.1 编码路径，dm-crypt 可直接使用受信密钥封装 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125180616.1854753-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- trusted keys 非对称密钥系列 v2 重发，补齐 asymmetric_keys Kconfig 依赖并更新文档 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124194043.1651679-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- trusted keys 非对称密钥系列初版，为 TPM 受信密钥引入公钥运算与封装密钥格式 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124120044.1481752-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` key_instantiate_and_link 期间阻止 key type 被注销，避免并发卸载导致的实例化悬空回调 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124174035.1614480-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- `bugfix` KEYCTL 实例化路径对 key type 取引用，防止 instantiate 方法在类型移除后仍被调用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124053303.940216-1-maguicai@kylinos.cn/)
- `bugfix` keyctl_pkey_e_d_s 改用 kfree_sensitive 释放中间缓冲，避免私钥相关数据残留在内存 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124052849.940005-1-maguicai@kylinos.cn/)
- `bugfix` trusted caam 正确传递受保护密钥选项解析错误，避免无效参数被静默接受 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124155310.32044-1-tkdkei@outlook.jp/)

## Scheduling
- `perf` `bugfix` sched_ext 修正 KF_RCU_PROTECTED kfunc 中可疑的 RCU 使用方式 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124103043.339553-1-jpiecuch@google.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` sched_ext 改为在 tick 中启动 ext_server，避免调度类切换与唤醒路径上的额外延迟 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125103420.2785659-1-tj@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `other` schedutil 在 PREEMPT_RT 上把 irq_work 放到硬中断上下文执行，降低调频延迟 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125103451.1385246-1-zhongqiu.han@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` sched/numa 修正扫描周期自适应逻辑与候选节点距离计算 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/CAMnMt5Zoj5z1nqcPCp7na72se9f19Ch7SaXBBtzJ_kp49FMLTQ@mail.gmail.com/)
- cgroup 支持列出 leader 已退出、线程仍存活的进程，避免遍历遗漏 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124033547.2373352-1-zhanxusheng1024@gmail.com/)
- cpuset/isolcpus 允许跳过 boot CPU 或禁止其被隔离使用，隔离语义更完整 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124042802.532633-1-longman@redhat.com/)
- sched_ext 更高优先级调度类赢得 pick 时重新入队 IMMED 任务，避免任务被搁置 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125114932.3198836-1-jpiecuch@google.com/)
- sched/core 迁移后不再把睡眠时间计入 run delay，延迟统计更准确、选核决策更可靠 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125115519.2373653-1-hwenwur@gmail.com/)
- sched/numa 不再依据过期的 NUMA 放置状态做决策，减少无效迁移与访存抖动 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124070011.2498455-1-arighi@nvidia.com/)
- `other` sched_ext sub: sub_caps_updated 不再运行在 SCX op 上下文中，减少加锁冲突 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125153353.1364467-1-jpiecuch@google.com/)

- mm/memcontrol: 在 memory.stat 中暴露匿名页与文件页回收统计，便于诊断回收行为 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261124-memcg-reclain-stat-v1-1-c6cb14b0d917@gmail.com/)

- `bugfix` mm/gup: 修复起始地址为 0 的范围无法触发缺页的问题，纠正边界判断 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261125173202.3636133-1-hengyul@cs.unc.edu/)
